summary: Marion County, Oregon: 1934 L-4 lookout cab on Pyramid Butte; removed or destroyed in 1952 per two sources; a 1953 district report says disposed of that year.

facts.status_note: Removed or destroyed in 1952 per the register and firelookout.com; a Lakes District report says it was condemned and disposed of in 1953

events.note: L-4 cab (a 14x14 model) constructed on the butte
Trail too steep and crooked for pack horses to carry lumber to the top (August 19, 1934 newspaper traveler)
Register says removed; firelookout.com says destroyed
Lakes District historical report: condemned and disposed of during the year (conflicts with the 1952 date)

evidence.supports: an L-4 lookout cab was built in 1934 (register)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: 1952 in the register and firelookout.com; the Lakes District report (1953 volume), quoted on the collection page, says the lookout was condemned and disposed of during 1953. The story reports both.
Removed (register) versus destroyed (firelookout.com). The story reports both words.

notes_for_editor: The brief lists this as kind 'ground' with design L-4; no tower is recorded, so the story calls it a lookout house. Removal year conflicts (1952 vs 1953) and the wording differs (removed vs destroyed); both are reported. The firelookout.com header puts the site in the Mt. Hood National Forest; the register says U.S. Forest Service, not contradicted. The 1934 traveler's passage is dated August 19, 1934 (Sunday Oregonian); the story now quotes the writer's steep-and-crooked wording rather than paraphrasing it as a cause. No staffing records found. Elevation per register is 6,095 ft (1,858 m). No photos with usable URLs were found. No access or current-condition information found.
